instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor martial arts studio with a grey floor and white walls. On the left foreground, the girl in the white uniform with a red belt (R4) performs a high block with her left arm raised and right fist at her hip. In the center background, the boy in the white uniform with a striped white belt (R2) stands with both arms raised in high blocks. On the right foreground, the girl in the orange uniform with a blue belt (R3) raises her left arm in a high block with her right fist at her hip. The three children face forward in a synchronized training formation under soft, diffused side lighting.
